value.rationale: The first nonzero Lyapunov curvature on the minimal-frequency Hessian null space is a natural structural obstruction to exact conjugacy: the family is tangent to the conjugacy orbit but generically not conjugate along the linear path. This supplies the complete degree-two trigonometric degeneracy kernel, a nontrivial quartic entropy deficit, strict sign and an exact 9:5 anisotropy. It is a meaningful precise local invariant motivated by parameter sensitivity of expanding-map entropy, not a routine numerical increment or a known-table recomputation.
